name: spend-meter
description: Session and per-turn cost above the prompt with a budget bar, a toast at 80% and a confirmation before the next prompt at 100%; collapses to one line.

budgetUsd.title: Session budget (US dollars)
budgetUsd.description: The budget the bar fills toward. 0 turns the budget off (the cost still shows). /spend-meter-budget changes it for later sessions too.

prices.title: Fallback prices (JSON)
prices.description: Only used when the host reports no session cost. {"model-id": {"input":0,"output":0,"cacheRead":0,"cacheWrite":0}} in US dollars per million tokens. Empty by default: fill in from your provider's price page.
